decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the outbuilding would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of No 45 Chiswick Lane and surrounding dwellings.  The proposal is not considered to be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties.  On balance, the development is considered to comply with the UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Alterations and Extensions) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the outbuilding hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The outbuilding shall be used for purposes ancillary to the use of the ground floor flat as a single family dwelling and for no other purpose
description: Retention of a single storey studio building in rear garden to be used as ancillary to ground floor flat
